summary:
Held 0 of today's 10 biggest UK/EU movers.

• 6 upside misses — BAYN.DE +5%, IHG.L +3%, ABF.L +2%, AI.PA +2%, CPG.L +2%. These cleared the universe screen but no strategy picked them up; the morning brief either filtered them on a catalyst/RSI/earnings rule or had nothing positive to trigger an entry.

• 4 downside moves (ASM.AS -8%, ASML.AS -6%, AAF.L -6%, ANTO.L -5%) are unreachable on a long-only basket — no mechanism to express a short or pair-trade.

• Most instructive miss: ASM.AS (-7.57%) — No confirmed same-day news found for ASM.AS. The -7.6% move looks like a semiconductor-equipment sector selloff (ASM, ASML and Besi often fall together on China export-curb or order-outlook worries). That is unverified. Why we passed: Outside any active strategy's universe: ASM International is a large-cap Dutch semicap listed on Euronext Amsterdam, and no uk-eu strategy includes it. With no pre-market catalyst, a sector-wide gap-down would also have failed momentum and news-reactive entry filters.
